Auditor
Physical Address:
524 Central Ave
New Rockford, ND 58356
Mailing Address:
524 Central Avenue
New Rockford, North Dakota 58356
Office Hours Regular hours Monday through Thursday 8am-4pm and Friday 8am-1pm
(701) 947-2434 (p) (701) 947-2279 (f)
The auditor's office is the hub of every courthouse. As defined in the NDCC Chapter 11-13, the auditor is the chief financial officer, the elections officer, personnel director, and the secretary to the county commission. Most auditors are responsible for a broad range of other administrative duties.
